part.text:
All 108 interval tests pass, including `TestIntervalBuilder.testEmptyIntervals` which verifies docID() returns -1 when unpositioned and NO_MORE_DOCS after advancing.

The fix in `lucene/queries/src/java/org/apache/lucene/queries/intervals/IntervalBuilder.java:255`: the `NO_INTERVALS` iterator now tracks its position with a `doc` field initialized to `-1`, so `docID()` correctly reports `-1` when unpositioned and `NO_MORE_DOCS` after `nextDoc()`/`advance()`, as required by the `DocIdSetIterator` contract.
